# Paola Mejia-Domenzain

> Researcher in machine learning for education. PhD from EPFL's Machine Learning for
> Education Laboratory (ML4ED). Works on self-regulated learning, multimodal learning
> analytics, interpretable student models, and large language models for education.
> Now building Scholé (https://schole.ai).

Canonical name: **Paola Mejia-Domenzain** (ASCII hyphen). Also published and indexed as
Paola Mejia, Mejia-Domenzain Paola, Paola Mejía-Domenzain, and — through a Unicode
normalisation error in some indexes — "Paola Mejia‐Domenzain" with U+2010. These all
refer to one person.

ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1242-3134
OpenAlex: https://openalex.org/A5081638871
Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=qG-UQgwAAAAJ
DBLP: https://dblp.org/pid/325/2389.html
GitHub: https://github.com/paola-md

## Named systems

- **Interpret3C** — interpretable student clustering with per-student feature selection.
- **RELEX** — retrieval of personalised worked examples for procedural writing.
- **GELEX** — generative-AI hybrid extension of RELEX for example-based learning.
- **TeamTeachingViz** — multimodal analytics dashboard for team-teaching reflection.
- **BloomTutor** — RAG-based tutoring system generating Bloom's-Taxonomy-aligned questions.
- **MCQStudentBert** — transformer forecasting a student's specific answer choice.
